name: Warm Diary
look: Personal, like a diary page: handwritten title, soft warm footage, words appear as they are said.

name: Bold Punch
look: Loud and fast: tall condensed title, yellow box captions that slam in, punchy colour, very lively cuts.

name: Editorial Serif
look: Magazine feel: italic serif title, light serif captions that fade up, muted contrasty colour.

name: Pastel Soft
look: Gentle and friendly: italic soft serif title, bouncy rounded captions, pastel colours and soft light.

name: Retro Groove
look: 70s poster: chunky retro title, karaoke fill captions, mustard and brown, film grain.

name: Minimal Lux
look: Quiet luxury: thin italic serif title in gold, small calm captions, deep contrast, slow pace.

name: Night Neon
look: Club night: wide display title, glowing neon captions, deep blue-green night colour.

name: Clean Creator
look: The everyday creator reel: bold clean sans, white captions with a small pop on the spoken word, natural colour.

name: Cinematic Promo
look: Film trailer: serif setup line then a huge condensed payoff word, warm-gold spoken word, cinematic colour, framing change every 2–4 s.

name: Tech Mono
look: Builder / product demo: monospace captions that appear word by word, cool blue colour, UI effects.

name: Handwritten Notes
look: Study notes: handwritten captions on a white tape box behind the spoken word, natural colour.

name: FeedMe Fun
look: Food and fun first: chunky title, bouncy pink captions, punchy colour, very lively.

name: One Big Word
look: One word at a time, huge, with a small punch-in; black and white footage so the word carries the colour.

name: Clean White
look: Minimal, premium talking head: white glowing captions that build a statement word by word with a blur-in, heavy sans mixed with an italic serif, sparse light leaks, and a silver 'clean-white' card set-piece. For one person talking, calm insight, 10–60 s.

caption.position: chest height (or above the head on a close selfie)

rules: hard cuts by default, at most 3 light leaks / flashes per 15 s
3–6 statement stacks per 15 s, never on the face
one punch-in (112–118 %) per talking-head segment
sound effects only on transitions, never on text
−15 LUFS, true peak −1.5

name: Cinema Lexicon
source: Editing Beast (approved there 17 Nov 2026; rebuilt 18 Nov 2026 on Alina's approved CL01 v6)
look: Words-led edit as in Alina's approved CL01 v6: the creator's take carries the voice, and every phrase that names a thing, an action or a feeling cuts to its own literal example clip (Pexels, never 3 in a row). The product's own brand frames it: a cream open card with a script word and huge caps, the app's real buttons dropping on the take, a button popping when it is named, swipe chips, the screen recording in a phone, a giant number, and for ads a close card with icon, chat bubbles and slogan. Small white captions cut on each word, one key word in three or four big. Swish on every cut, pops on buttons, a funky bed 9 dB under the voice.

caption.mode: 1–3 words cut on the word, no motion; 1 key word in 3–4 alone and big (caps ≤ 5 letters, else italic)
caption.position: low on the take (82 %), mid on example clips (49 %), high while buttons drop, dark on cream cards

rules: one phrase that names a thing, action or feeling → one literal example clip that acts out its human meaning (Pexels, no watermark); never 3 in a row, the creator's take between
no clips on the product's own moments ('this app', 'over here'): the take, or the product's real UI, shows those
the brand comes from the product: its colours, display font, icon, screens and real buttons (brand kit)
open card on the first call to action; close card only for ads, and the last frame held 1.3 s; interviews end on the punchline
captions small and cut on the word; a key word in 3–4 alone and big
swish on every clip cut, pops on buttons, a reverse rise into cards, bed ~9 dB under the voice, −15 LUFS
'no pictures' in the brief: no clips, punch-ins on the key words, captions on the chest (CL02)
fonts_status: the brand kit's display face replaces Lilita One when it has one

pacing.value: Medium pace, a new picture every 1.7 s, no punch-ins (CL01 v6 measured: 34 cuts a minute, 0 punch-ins)

name: Neon Dimension
look: High-energy explainer: the talking head keeps cutting into dark neon worlds; on the presenter, 1–2 words in wide glowing white caps at chest height; in the worlds, a small lead-in plus a huge skewed neon key word; a light burn or glitch on every change; grain and vignette over everything.
rules: a neon key word for every concrete claim, number, problem or result (50–60 % of the runtime)
one neon colour per moment: green money/yes, red problem, cyan calm/tech, purple AI/game, pink desire
a light burn or glitch with a sub boom + swish on every change
a neon pill for the CTA at the end
music bed 7–8 dB under the voice, about −14.5 LUFS

name: Meme Chaos
source: Editing Beast draft 18 Nov 2026, learned from Alina's final dumb-scale edit (17 Nov 2026)
look: One uncut office take of friends doing a challenge, kept raw; every person's turn gets its own meme moment (explosion, disco lights, XP wallpaper, big-face warp, clapping-cat sticker, crash line), each with a meme sound on the exact frame; zoom pulses on claps; a wavy sparkle hook over the first seconds; plain white captions low on the frame; upbeat music bed that switches to elevator music for the punchline.

caption.box: none, thin dark outline + soft shadow

rules: keep the take raw: cut only dead waits (1–3 s with nothing happening); no transitions, hard cuts only
one meme moment per person's turn, never the same effect twice; the effect and its sound land on the same frame
a meme sound on every entrance and big moment (Spawn, Vine boom, Windows XP, Faa, explosion); applause on real claps
clap zoom pulses (1.05–1.08, 0.2 s) whenever people clap
music: an upbeat bed ~2 dB under the voice in the intro, level with it after; switch to elevator music for the punchline
mix at −14.5 LUFS integrated; meme hits 2–9 dB over the speech, the biggest (Windows XP, Faa) loudest

name: Butter Steps
look: Calm locked-off talking head teaching a process in N steps: a step header (yellow STEP n + white caps) and clean white UI cards in the top third, one-word lowercase captions at chest height with key words in butter yellow, a serif-italic hook title over a wall of past reels, voice only, ends in 'comment WORD'.

caption.mode: one word at a time, lowercase

rules: jump cuts only, no zooms, no transitions
every on-screen change hits its word
voice only, no music, about −14 LUFS

name: Star Glitch
look: Chatty locked-off talking head where the captions are the design: one cream colour (#FBFCDA), one ultra-tight heavy grotesk, no stroke or shadow, sized by importance and scattered, with (asides), >quotes< and a typing_ cursor; an identity sting (★ glitch name, counter, script logo, zoom-through into a fast music montage), big PiP screen recordings, a payoff card, then 'ok bye !'.

caption.mode: one word at a time, hard cut, sized by importance

rules: captions cream #FBFCDA, no stroke/shadow, hard cuts on the word
jump cuts only, no punch-ins, no grade
identity sting: ★ glitch name, counter, script logo, zoom-through into a 0.3 s-per-cut montage
music only under the montage (about 5 dB under the voice)
−15 LUFS
